_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Conflicting forces—hot momentum and ETF flows versus extreme VIX, gold flight, and Fed liquidity at 2—cancel each other in a coiling stalemate where no directional base rate is available and the breaker (liquidity injection or drain) has not yet arrived.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both agree the market is coiling in Hope, but the analyst holds neutral awaiting a catalyst while the narrative leans bearish on fading momentum and a blowoff-top analog
next_move.confirmed_if: Fed liquidity rises above 20 with VIX compression below 50 and funding rates climbing above 65
next_move.invalidated_if: Fed liquidity stays below 10 with VIX remaining above 60 and BTC funding turning negative, or exchange netflow spikes above 50 with reserves dropping
